description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): ERFC.PRECISE at 8,000 points in (0.5, 26.54), four times denser than kmyst-erfc-dense, with Excel's own exp(-fl(x*x)), to map the smooth +-2.5 ulp error curve of the erfc rational (its extrema, their spacing near x = 8 and 26.6, and any jumps) to about 0.2 ulp per 0.25-wide bin. Row k+1 (k = 0..7999) is x = 0.5 + (k + 0.5 + 0.381966*(((7k) mod 5) - 2)/5)*0.003255. A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)).
